compendium.summary: A concentration-based undead combat group for campaigns allowing Xanathar's material. Treat corpse access, commands and encounter pace as real costs.
warnings: Expanded-source permission is required; owning the book or seeing a spell in a builder is not campaign approval.
Tier is a situational Compendium assessment, not a letter grade quoted from Pack Tactics.
Full paid spell mechanics were not independently rechecked; consult the linked active entry before using detailed interactions.
tactics: This fills a different role from Animate Dead's persistent, upkeep-based minions. Do not transfer duration, control or concentration rules between them.
The research compares it favorably with legacy Animate Objects. That is not evidence that its old damage comparison applies unchanged to 2024 spells or revised monster statistics.
Use a compact initiative and command procedure agreed with the DM. Extra bodies should not turn every round into an extended bookkeeping exercise.

research.note: Prompted by the supplied Pack Tactics research package. Video timestamps are its attribution trail, not independently verified quotations; editorial advice is separated from official spell access.
